integrity: The exact integral matrices in the originating open manuscript were transcribed and used for an exhaustive standard-library group verifier. Source priors and possible indirect coverage are acknowledged. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The four specified affine quotient representations only; calculations are exhaustive for their finite matrix groups, not a classification of all dimension-four quotients. General Benson theorem is cited; published complete-intersection and nonresolution inputs are not reproved. Equivalent computations may exist in earlier group tabulations.
title: Divisor-class torsion and an anti-invariant double cover among four-dimensional complete-intersection quotient counterexamples
